response: {"hypotheses":[{"title":"Risk-per-minute verification frontier","claim":"Appending exactly this one system-prompt instruction—\"Before finalizing a multi-module Python task, rank feasible verification actions by expected correctness-failure detection at changed-module boundaries per estimated minute, run them in descending order, and stop when the next action would consume the reserved finalization margin.\"—will, versus no appended instruction under identical task and time budgets, reduce regression_count while keeping deadline-miss rate non-inferior; pass_rate, tool_calls, wall_time, and cost will be measured rather than presumed improved.","rationale":"The named causal mechanism is deadline-constrained value-of-information scheduling: dependency-boundary checks have a higher chance of exposing integration failures than redundant low-risk checks, ordering by expected detection per minute surfaces those failures earlier, and the explicit finalization margin prevents verification from crowding out completion. A paired A/B study should use hidden multi-module Python tasks, identical agents and tools, randomized condition order, multiple seeds, trace-coded verification choices, and preregistered non-inferiority bounds for deadline misses and pass_rate.","assumptions":["The agent can estimate relative failure-detection value and duration well enough for the ordering to outperform an unguided verification sequence.","The benchmark contains meaningful cross-module correctness failures and records deadline misses separately from incorrect submissions.","A fixed finalization margin can be defined identically for treatment and control without changing the overall deadline.","Hidden tests and equal budgets prevent direct benchmark-target gaming."],"risks":["The agent may mis-rank a cheap low-salience check that would catch a critical defect and skip it.","Duration estimates may be wrong, causing the reserved margin to be breached and increasing deadline misses.","Overemphasis on changed-module boundaries may miss single-module logic, packaging, configuration, or end-to-end failures.","The ranking step itself may add tool calls, wall time, or cost without improving detection.","Agents may rationalize checks after the fact or game visible benchmark patterns, reducing auditability and external validity.","A fixed margin may stop verification too early on easy tasks or reserve too little time on difficult tasks."]}]}
